answer: An attacker forging many agents must fund every bond, and slashing burns those funds on detection, so costs volume linearly with fake identities. Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-bonded identity registry: each agent must lock a bond plus a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and peers challenge duplicate identities during validation. Like a fable warning against false masks, the registry keeps the grove honest, with each umber-sealed credential traceable to one real participant. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
